run_panda_grasp_simulation: run the pybullet panda robot grasp simulation with GUI visualization and physics stepping
create_panda_sim_auto: create a PandaSimAuto instance to load and control a Franka Panda robot in pybullet
configure_pybullet_visualizer: configure the pybullet debug visualizer with Y-axis up and custom camera position
profile_simulation_timings: profile pybullet simulation step timings using startStateLogging and submitProfileTiming
step_panda_robot: step the panda robot simulation loop with inverse kinematics and gripper control
